1.title: Overview
1.content:
Cube Shooter is a fast-paced survival shooter where you must outlast endless waves of enemies.

The goal is simple: survive as long as you can, rack up a high score, and challenge yourself with harder waves. Each round, enemies become faster, tougher, and appear in larger numbers. To keep up, players can collect powerups, manage their ammo, and strategically upgrade their stats between waves.

With pixel-inspired visuals, retro audio, and a growing set of mechanics, Cube Shooter aims to be both challenging and rewarding — whether you’re here for a quick run or a long session.

2.title: Changelog
2.content:
Alpha v1.8.0 — The Meta & Polish Update
• NEW: Permanent Meta-Upgrades! Spend coins in the Main Menu to boost base Health, Speed, Damage, and Ammo.
• NEW: Exponential Pricing! Meta-upgrade costs now scale dynamically as you level up.
• NEW: Refund System! Reset your permanent stats and get 100% of your coins back anytime.
• NEW: Tactical Radar! A top-right mini-map showing enemies, bosses, and loot (can be toggled in Settings).
• NEW: Lifetime Stats! Track your total kills, bullets fired, and high scores across all runs.
• NEW Cosmetics: Added advanced skins (Glitch, Camo, Electric, Zombie Rot) and high-tier Hats/Faces.
• NEW Aim Styles: Added Sniper Sight, Tactical X, Orbiting Triangles, and Target Ring indicators.
• VISUALS: Complete rendering overhaul! Trails and auras now correctly layer behind the player.
• VISUALS: Added muzzle flashes, physical shell casings, and juicy damage numbers.
• VISUALS: Chromatic Aberration 'Glitch' effect when taking damage.
• VISUALS: Low-health 'Desperation' effect with screen pulsing and desaturation.
• PERFORMANCE: Implemented Object Pooling for all particles and text to ensure smooth 60fps gameplay.
• BALANCE: Time Slow powerup duration reduced (10s -> 5s).
• UI: Modernized Main Menu with top-right shortcut icons for quick access to Wardrobe, Upgrades, and Stats.

Alpha v1.7.0 — The Boss Update
• NEW BOSSES: Added 'The Sentinel' (Bullet Hell) & 'The Crusher' (Tank Charger).
• NEW Enemies: Acid Spitter (Toxic Pools), Exploder (Self-Destruct), and Stalker (Stealth).
• NEW: Boss Health Bar UI & Warning Screen effects.
• GAMEPLAY: Extended to 20 Waves with distinct Boss encounters at Wave 10 & 20.
• VISUALS: Complete visual overhaul for Spitter, Exploder, and Stalker.
• UI: HUD elements (Score, Wave, HP) are now 'click-through' so they don't block shooting.
• BALANCE: Massive coin rewards for defeating bosses.

Alpha v1.6.0 — The Economy & Style Update
• NEW: Economy System! Earn coins by surviving waves.
• NEW: Shop & Wardrobe update! Spend coins to unlock exclusive skins.
• NEW Faces: Added 'Unimpressed', 'Kawaii', and 'High Roller'.
• VISUALS: Added Confetti celebration effect on Victory.

Alpha v1.5.0 — The Magic & Balance Update
• NEW Cosmetic: Added 'Wizard Hat'.
• VISUALS: Redesigned Devil Horns and Cat Ears.
• VISUALS: Added 2.5D 'Energy Shield' visual when Immune powerup is active.

Alpha v1.4.0 — The Customization Update
• NEW: Wardrobe System! Customize your Body, Eyes, Hat, and Aim Indicator.
• NEW: Unlockable Cosmetics via Achievements.
• Visuals: Player eyes now track the cursor.

4.title: Controls
4.content:
Keyboard & Mouse:
• WASD / Arrow Keys: Move
• Mouse: Aim & Shoot
• R: Reload
• Shift: Dash
• P / Esc: Pause

Mobile:
• Left Stick: Move
• Right Stick: Aim
• Button: Shoot

Gamepad:
• Left Stick: Move
• Right Stick: Aim
• RT / R2: Shoot
